# stalwart_imap (Resource)

Configures IMAP protocol settings including authentication, timeouts, and rate limits. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_plain_text_auth` (Boolean) Whether to allow plain text authentication on unencrypted connections
- `max_auth_failures` (Number) Number of authentication attempts a user can make before being disconnected by the server
- `max_concurrent` (Number) The maximum number of concurrent connections
- `max_messages_per_command` (Number) Maximum number of messages processed by a single FETCH, SEARCH, STORE, MOVE or UID EXPUNGE command, announced to clients through the MESSAGELIMIT capability. Lowering this truncates results for clients that do not implement RFC 9738
- `max_messages_per_save` (Number) Maximum number of messages accepted by a single COPY or APPEND command, announced to clients through the SAVELIMIT capability. These commands are atomic, so exceeding the limit stores nothing; keep it at or above the MESSAGELIMIT value
- `max_request_rate` (Attributes) The maximum number of requests per minute (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--max_request_rate))
- `max_request_size` (Number) Maximum size of an IMAP request that the server will accept
- `max_uid_batches` (Number) Maximum number of UID ranges returned by a single UIDBATCHES command; wider requests are rejected with a TOOMANY response code
- `min_uid_batch_size` (Number) Smallest batch size a client may ask for in a UIDBATCHES command; smaller requests are rejected with a TOOFEW response code. Cannot exceed 500, which is the batch size every server is required to support
- `timeout_anonymous` (Number) Time an unauthenticated session can stay inactive before being ended by the server
- `timeout_authenticated` (Number) Time an authenticated session can remain idle before the server terminates it
- `timeout_idle` (Number) Time a connection can stay idle in the IMAP IDLE state before the server breaks the connection

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
